title: Principal Product Manager
jd_excerpt:
NVIDIA Kumo is seeking a seasoned and diligent Principal Product Manager to join our growing product organization. In this critical role, you will lead the successful execution of complex projects across ISVs and partners, ensuring timely delivery, high quality, and collaborating closely with leadership. As a Product Manager at NVIDIA, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the development and success of our product, which enables organizations to build Predictive Agents that learn over private historical data and provide best in class accuracy.  
 You'll be collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the timely delivery of major features and solutions that meet customer needs on a per-release basis. You would be responsible for product management operations, user research, defining the CUJs, driving the product roadmap, and ensuring the timely delivery of major features and solutions that meet customer needs on a per-release basis. 
 What you will be doing: 
 Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of AI projects from inception to completion, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps and business goals. 
 Break down complex AI projects into manageable tasks and develop detailed project plans with timelines, achievements, and prioritization. 
 Manage project risks and dependencies, proactively identifying and mitigating potential issues. 
 Track project progress, monitor critical metrics, and report on project status to collaborators. 
 Facilitate regular team meetings, communication channels, and collaboration between engineering, data science, and product teams. 
 Manage project budgets and ensure efficient resource utilization. 
 Document project plans, requirements, and processes for future reference. 
 Stay up-to-date on the latest project management methodologies and best practices. 
 What we need to see: 
 15 years of experience in technical program management and/or product management, preferably within the SaaS or enterprise software industry. 
 Prior experience working on AI/ML projects is a strong plus. 
 MS or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 
 Solid understanding of the product development process (PDP) and software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies, specifically Agile and Scrum. 
 Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, designers, and product managers. 
 Extensive experience in defining projects, risk identification, scope coordination, dependency recognition, scheduling, and the deployment of new products and features. 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and foster a collaborative team environment. 
 Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to problem-solving. 
 Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Asana, or Trello.
Working knowledge of Machine Learning (ML) concepts and their application in software development. 
 NVIDIA offers comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; flexible, generous paid time off; parental leave; and ongoing learning and development support!
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
 Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 29, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
 NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
